title.narrative: Emergency Food Assistance and Protection Response in Munigi groupement, Nyiragongo territory

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to save lives and alleviate suffering by providing basic Food Assistance items and protection support services to at least 12,000 people in Munigi groupement, Nyiragongo territory, North Kivu Province. Food assistance will target most vulnerable 1,377 HHs (about 9,639 people) who will be receive food rations at 100% of the Minimum Expenditure Basket (MEB) as per the standards that are in alignment with the guidelines of the food security cluster in DRC. The basket for each household will include 50kg of corn flour, 10kg of beans, 3 litters of oil and 1kg of salt. This 100% of food basket ration will enable households access and meet their basic and immediate food needs. Distribution sites will be selected based on their proximity to target populations. During distributions, priority will be given to people with specific needs (PLWs, elderly people, people living with disabilities or disease and female and child HHs). A risk analysis will be carried out before distribution to ensure that all preventive measures are taken into account to reduce the risk of exposing the beneficiaries to various forms of harm and ensure the protection of beneficiaries. Protection support services will be provided through awareness raising activities on general protection, GBV and child protection. Protection activities will target at least 12,000 people in Munigi IDP site, with specific focus on Female Headed Households (FHH), People with Disability (PWD), families with members who are elderly, sick, and children under five. Key considerations will be made to ensure specific safety, privacy and security needs of women, girls, men, boys and people with special needs are addressed during delivery of protection activities. The project will be implemented by CAFOD, in collaboration with Anglican Church (Goma Diocese), for a period of three months. Expected project impact is improved access of households to basic food items, and better protection mechanism for the most vulnerable in Munigi IDP site. Implementation of project activities will mainstream gender and persons with special needs’ priorities and participation.
